name: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd
title: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre Ltd - 543350 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Vijaya Diagnostic Q4 FY26 revenue up 26.6% on 18.5% volume, EBITDA margin 43.5%; capex guided INR 140-150 crore for FY27 with 4-5 hubs and 10-12 spokes, a volume-led expansion rather than a supply-discipline signal.

utilisation.quote: we have a little bit of capacity constraint

capex.quote: the capital outlook of what Ankit has given is keeping in mind the entire , 4 hubs of what has been signed and the automated lab and the 10 - 12 spokes that are coming.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue growth 26.6%
triggers.quote: reflecting a strong revenue growth rate of 26.6% Y -o-Y

triggers.label: Price hike 1-1.5% planned FY27
triggers.quote: this year also we'll be taking roughly about 1% to 1.5% of price hike

triggers.label: EBITDA margin guided 40%+
triggers.quote: we'll still be delivering 30% plus EBITDA margin

guidance.quote: we feel that we'll be able to comfortably deliver more than 40%
While we may have that 1% - 1.5% of realization growth

guidance.metric: Capex FY27 (new centres and automated lab)
guidance.quote: the capital outlay for the new centers, including the lab, the new automated lab, is estimated to be INR 140 crores to INR 150 crores
It'll be around INR 10 crores to INR 15 crores.

prior_guidance_check.quote: that was the only one guidance which did not happen according to our guidance, which we gave three years back
